findings.summary: Carried over unchanged (the dev disclosed it and left it as is): the J4 trigger test never changes a contact key, so it does not guard the presentPairs fix in FoldContacts
findings.scenario: Reverting the JoltBackend.cpp presentPairs change leaves the test green; the path where a shape is rebuilt while the contact is only speculative stays untested

findings.summary: Carried over unchanged (the dev disclosed it and left it as is): SortByPick is O(n^2), and Jolt's RaycastAll has no 1024 cap
findings.scenario: A Jolt RaycastAll through ~20k hits does ~4e8 operations where the old sort was n log n, which causes a frame-time spike
